objective: Change holyagent's stack rule so new work stacks on the top of the repository's open stack, after bringing the base into a stack that lags it, and branches from the base only when the repository asks for independent PRs.
scope: Work only in the worktree /home/user/holyagent-stack-rule (branch claude/intelligent-dijkstra-x7njap-stack-rule at f837317, which has main's instruction files).

In this maintainer's repository the convention is stacked PRs, yet PRs 31-45 were all opened from main while an open stack (PR 35 -> 36, 35 -> 37) sat unmerged and fell 7 commits behind main. The maintainer decided: new work stacks on the top of the open stack, and branches from the base only when the repository's conventions ask for independent PRs.

Required behavior to state in the instructions: (a) before branching, find the open PRs of the repository (`gh pr list` / the REST API) and their bases; new work, whether part of the current delivery or not, stacks on the top of the open stack (the newest open PR head whose chain reaches the base); when several open chains exist, stack on the one the work depends on, else the most recent; (b) when the stack lags the base, first merge the base forward into the lowest stack branch and up the chain with merge commits, with a review of each merged head before any push (the existing merge-forward rule), before stacking new work; (c) branch from the base only when the repository's conventions ask for independent PRs, or when no PR is open; (d) the CI-PR-first rule and the rest of the stack plan stay as they are. Keep the rules concise and in the existing calm style; the replacement should be about the same size as the text it replaces, at most two extra sentences.
